name: CrafterPlay-Survival
description: CrafterPlay-Survival: 20,000 expert gameplay episodes (176.7M frames) in Craftax-Classic, generated by a PPO-RNN expert trained with the Survival reward (base achievement reward + death penalty). Each episode includes rendered video, actions, environment states, episode length, and rule-based CrafterCaption annotations. Part of CrafterDojo, an integrated research suite for building open-ended embodied agents in Crafter.

rai:dataLimitations: This dataset is limited to simulated Craftax-Classic gameplay generated by agents, not humans. It may not generalize to real-world settings, other games, human behavior, or different task/environment configurations. Rare states, alternative strategies, and agent failure modes may be underrepresented.
rai:dataBiases: The dataset is biased toward the behavior of the specific agents, policies, tasks, and environment settings used during collection. It may not represent human gameplay, diverse player skill levels, or strategies outside those produced by the generating agents.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. The dataset contains simulated gameplay trajectories and does not include personal or sensitive information.
rai:dataUseCases:
The dataset is intended to represent agent gameplay behavior and environment interaction
in the Crafter domain. It can support research on offline reinforcement
learning, behavior modeling, representation learning, and policy evaluation within this
simulator.
rai:dataSocialImpact: This dataset may support research on offline reinforcement learning, representation learning, and agent evaluation in simulated environments, helping researchers study scalable gameplay data without collecting human data.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.prov:label: Dataset Generation
prov:wasGeneratedBy.sc:description: The dataset was generated from Craftax-Classic gameplay using PPO-RNN agents. Raw trajectories were collected from agent-environment interactions.
